subject: Re: Fw: End-to-end MRI pipeline @ Cerebriu (Callum from Encord)
text:
Hi Callum,

Its actually quite the opposite. In the current landscape we do not see any vendor being able to provide a solution that would cover our need for curation (here meaning both choosing which data to annotate and choosing what data to use for which application, i.e. trianing/validation splitting and such). The complexity of the MR data metadata subspace simply requires too much domain knowledge that a non-MR dedicated platform is unlikely to work. You would likely argue, that your platform can be made so flexible that we can do the configuration ourselves, but I see little value in that compared to doing a full solution ourselves. As an example see dcm2bids: It can almost do what we would need from a technical solution perspective, but the setup still requires significant domain knowledge to setup a configuration file. Even with dcm2bids being open-source we have opted for building an in-house solution, as the primary work is not in the technical solution  - its in the domain knowledge needed to make it work.

As such we are only looking for a stable annotation tool from a 3rd party provider and if Redbrick are going to focus on doing that (i.e. adapting "doing one thing but doing it great") that would only be a possitive in our book.

Kind regards,
